welcome.subject: Welcome to {productName}
welcome.heading: Welcome to {productName}
welcome.body: Your email address is confirmed and your account is ready. You can sign in and get started right away.

orderConfirmation.subject: Your {productName} order is confirmed: {planName}
orderConfirmation.preview: Thanks for your order. Here are the details.
orderConfirmation.heading: Your order is confirmed
orderConfirmation.body: Thanks for your order. Here are the details.
orderConfirmation.receiptNote: Your receipt comes in a separate email from Paddle, our payment provider and reseller.

shopOrderConfirmation.subject: Your {productName} order is confirmed: {orderId}
shopOrderConfirmation.preview: Thanks for your order. Here are the items and the delivery address.
shopOrderConfirmation.heading: Your order is confirmed
shopOrderConfirmation.body: Thanks for your order. We received your payment and will start preparing it.

priceChange.subject: Your {productName} {planName} price changes on {effectiveDate}
priceChange.heading: Your price is changing
priceChange.bodyPriceIncrease: The price of your {planName} plan will change from {from} to {to}, starting {effectiveDate}.
priceChange.bodyTrialToPaid: Your free trial of {planName} ends on {effectiveDate}. After that, the plan costs {to}.
priceChange.consentDeadline: To continue at the new price, please accept by {consentBy}.
priceChange.noResponse: If we do not hear from you by then, we will not charge the new price. No response is not consent.
priceChange.declineNote: If you do not want to continue, you can cancel your subscription before {effectiveDate}.

cancellation.subject: Your {productName} subscription is canceled
cancellation.heading: Your subscription is canceled
cancellation.bodyAccessEnded: Your access to paid features has ended.
cancellation.noFurtherCharges: You will not be charged again.

paymentFailed.subject: Your {productName} payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.preview: Update your payment method to keep your plan.
paymentFailed.heading: We couldn't take your payment
paymentFailed.body: Your last payment for {productName} didn't go through, so your plan is now past due.
paymentFailed.retryOn: Our payment provider will try your card again on {retryDate}.
paymentFailed.retryAuto: Our payment provider will try your card again automatically over the next few days.
paymentFailed.accessUntil: You can keep using your paid features until {accessUntil}. After that they pause until a payment goes through.
paymentFailed.fix: The quickest fix is to update your payment method.

inquiryNotice.subject: New inquiry {reference} on {productName}
inquiryNotice.preview: Someone sent an inquiry through your site.
inquiryNotice.heading: You have a new inquiry
inquiryNotice.body: Someone sent an inquiry through the {form} form. Reply to them using the contact details below.
inquiryNotice.retentionNote: This inquiry is deleted automatically on {deleteOn}.
inquiryNotice.why: You are receiving this email because inquiries to {productName} are sent to this address.

inquiryReceipt.subject: We received your inquiry to {productName}
inquiryReceipt.heading: We received your inquiry
inquiryReceipt.body: Thanks for getting in touch. We will reply to the contact details you left.
inquiryReceipt.responseNote: We usually reply within {responseTime}. If you have not heard from us by then, send a new message and quote this reference.
inquiryReceipt.notYou: If you did not send this inquiry, you can ignore this email.
inquiryReceipt.why: You are receiving this email because you sent an inquiry to {productName}.

inquiryReply.subject: Our reply to your {productName} inquiry
inquiryReply.heading: We replied to your inquiry
inquiryReply.body: Thanks for waiting. Here is our reply to the inquiry you sent us.
inquiryReply.notYou: If you did not send this inquiry, you can ignore this email.
inquiryReply.why: You are receiving this email because you sent an inquiry to {productName}.

bookingConfirmation.subject: Your {productName} booking is confirmed
bookingConfirmation.heading: Your booking is confirmed
bookingConfirmation.body: Your booking with {productName} is confirmed. Please check the details below.
bookingConfirmation.requestedBody: We received your booking request. We will email you again once it is confirmed.
bookingConfirmation.reminderBody: Your booking is coming up soon. Here are the details again.
bookingConfirmation.cancelNote: You can cancel it yourself until {cancelBy}. You will need the booking reference and the contact you booked with.
bookingConfirmation.notYou: If you did not make this booking, you can ignore this email.
bookingConfirmation.why: You are receiving this email because you made a booking with {productName}.
bookingConfirmation.depositPendingSubject: Pay the deposit for your {productName} booking
bookingConfirmation.depositPendingHeading: We are waiting for your deposit
bookingConfirmation.depositPendingBody: Your booking continues once the deposit is paid. If it is not paid in time, we release the slot.
bookingConfirmation.depositPendingNote: Please pay by {payBy}. If there is no payment by then, the booking is canceled automatically. Nothing is charged unless you pay.
bookingConfirmation.depositRefundAll: Cancel by {fullBefore} for a full refund of the deposit. After that, the deposit is not refunded.
bookingConfirmation.depositRefundPartial: Cancel by {fullBefore} for a full refund of the deposit. After that, {percent}% of the deposit is refunded.

bookingCancellation.subject: Your {productName} booking was canceled
bookingCancellation.heading: Your booking was canceled
bookingCancellation.bookerBody: As you asked, we canceled your booking.
bookingCancellation.ownerBody: We had to cancel your booking. We are sorry for the trouble.
bookingCancellation.systemBody: Your booking was canceled. Contact us if you have questions.
bookingCancellation.notYou: If you did not make this booking, you can ignore this email.
bookingCancellation.why: You are receiving this email because you made a booking with {productName}.
bookingCancellation.depositExpiredBody: The deposit was not paid in time, so the booking was canceled. Nothing was charged.
bookingCancellation.depositRefundedBody: We refunded the deposit. Depending on your card issuer, it can take a few days to show up.
bookingCancellation.depositPartialBody: The cancellation deadline had passed, so only part of the deposit was refunded. Depending on your card issuer, it can take a few days to show up.
bookingCancellation.depositForfeitedBody: The cancellation deadline had passed, so the deposit is not refunded.

bookingNotice.subject: New booking {reference} on {productName}
bookingNotice.heading: You have a new booking
bookingNotice.requestedHeading: You have a new booking request
bookingNotice.body: A booking came in and was confirmed right away. Please check the details below.
bookingNotice.requestedBody: A booking request came in. Please review it and confirm it.
bookingNotice.retentionNote: This booking is deleted automatically on {deleteOn}.
bookingNotice.why: You are receiving this email because bookings for {productName} are sent to this address.
bookingNotice.depositPaidNote: The deposit for this booking has been paid.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for {productName}
verifyEmail.preview: Confirm this email address for your {productName} account.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Please confirm that this is your email address. We use it for receipts, password resets and security notices.
verifyEmail.expiryNote: This link works for {duration}. If it has expired, you can ask for a new one after signing in.
verifyEmail.ignoreNote: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
verifyEmail.notMeNote: Didn't create this account? Use the link below and we will delete it.

emailChangeConfirm.subject: Approve your {productName} email change
emailChangeConfirm.preview: Someone asked to change your sign-in email to {newEmail}.
emailChangeConfirm.heading: Approve your email change
emailChangeConfirm.body: We received a request to change the email address of your {productName} account to {newEmail}.
emailChangeConfirm.nextStep: After you approve, we will send a confirmation link to the new address. The change happens only when that link is used.
emailChangeConfirm.securityNote: If you did not ask for this, do not use the button and change your password.
emailChangeConfirm.expiryNote: This link works for {duration}, then it stops working.

emailChanged.subject: Your {productName} email address was changed
emailChanged.heading: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.body: The email address of your {productName} account was changed to {newEmail}. We will send account emails there from now on.
emailChanged.securityNote: If you did not make this change, reset your password right away and contact us.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your {productName} password
passwordReset.preview: Use this link to choose a new password for your {productName} account.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password of your {productName} account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
passwordReset.expiryNote: This link works for {duration}. If it has expired, you can ask for a new one from the sign-in page.
passwordReset.ignoreNote: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password will not change.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {productName} password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your {productName} account was changed on {changedAt}.
passwordChanged.securityNote: If you did not make this change, reset your password right away and contact us.

accountDeletionRequested.subject: We received your request to delete your {productName} account
accountDeletionRequested.preview: We will delete your account on {graceUntil} unless you sign in before then.
accountDeletionRequested.heading: We received your deletion request
accountDeletionRequested.body: You asked us to delete your {productName} account. We will delete it on {graceUntil}.
accountDeletionRequested.undo: To keep your account, sign in before that date. Signing in cancels the deletion.
accountDeletionRequested.kept: When we delete the account, we remove your profile, sign-in details and notification choices. We keep payment and transaction records only for the period the law requires. These records carry no name or email.
accountDeletionRequested.securityNote: If you did not ask for this, sign in now to cancel it and then change your password.

marketingConsentNotice.subject: {senderName} processed your marketing message preferences
marketingConsentNotice.preview: Here is the result of your opt-in or opt-out request.
marketingConsentNotice.heading: Result of your marketing message preferences
marketingConsentNotice.intro: Sender: {senderName} — We processed your marketing message preferences as follows.
marketingConsentNotice.resultGranted: Result: your opt-in has been applied.
marketingConsentNotice.resultWithdrawn: Result: your opt-out has been applied. We will not send marketing messages through this channel.
marketingConsentNotice.manageNote: You can change your preferences in your account settings at any time. This is a notice of the result required by law, not an advertisement.

newDeviceSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your {productName} account
newDeviceSignIn.preview: A device we haven't seen before signed in to {productName}.
newDeviceSignIn.heading: New sign-in to your account
newDeviceSignIn.body: Your {productName} account was just signed in to from a device we haven't seen before.
newDeviceSignIn.ifYou: If this was you, you don't need to do anything.
newDeviceSignIn.ifNotYou: If this wasn't you, secure your account now. Reset your password, and everyone else is signed out.

marketingReconfirm.subject: {productName}: do you still want our marketing emails?
marketingReconfirm.preview: We check every two years that you still want marketing emails.
marketingReconfirm.heading: Do you still want our marketing emails?
marketingReconfirm.intro: Sender: {senderName} — You agreed to receive marketing emails from us on {consentDate}.
marketingReconfirm.why: We check every two years that you still want these emails, as the law requires.
marketingReconfirm.noResponse: If you do nothing, nothing changes: you keep getting these emails until you unsubscribe.
marketingReconfirm.unsubscribeNote: You can unsubscribe at any time with the second button. You don't need to sign in.

advertising.adNotice: This is an advertisement sent by {senderName} to people who agreed to receive its marketing emails.
advertising.optOutLead: Don't want these emails? Unsubscribe in one click. You don't need to sign in.

newsletterConfirm.subject: Confirm your {productName} newsletter subscription
newsletterConfirm.preview: One click to start getting our email updates.
newsletterConfirm.heading: Confirm your subscription
newsletterConfirm.body: Someone asked to get {productName} email updates at this address. Confirm below to start. Until you do, we won't send you anything.
newsletterConfirm.ignoreNote: If this wasn't you, just ignore this email. We won't send you anything, and we delete the request soon.
newsletterConfirm.why: You are receiving this because this address was entered on the {productName} newsletter form. If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email.

newsletterWelcome.subject: You're subscribed to {productName} updates
newsletterWelcome.heading: You're subscribed
newsletterWelcome.intro: Sender: {senderName} — You agreed to receive {productName} email updates on {consentDate}.
newsletterWelcome.result: Result: your subscription is confirmed. You'll get our updates at this address.
newsletterWelcome.unsubscribeNote: Don't want them anymore? Unsubscribe any time with the button below. You don't need to sign in.
newsletterWelcome.notice: This is the notice of your sign-up required by law, not an advertisement.
newsletterWelcome.why: You are receiving this because you confirmed your subscription to {productName} updates.

transfer.title: International transfers of personal data
transfer.intro: To run the service, we entrust the processing of personal data to the companies below, which transfers it outside Korea.
transfer.whenHow: Sent over the network whenever you use the service

items.analytics: Usage events (pages viewed, clicks), device and browser information, internal user ID
items.email: Email address, name (if provided), email content
items.errors: Error reports, internal user ID, device and browser information (IP addresses and cookies are masked)
items.hosting: All data exchanged while using the service, including IP address and access logs
items.botCheck: IP address, browser information (User-Agent, TLS fingerprint)
items.database: Account and service data we store (profile, plan status, messages), kept in the region shown

purpose.botCheck: Blocking automated abuse on sign-up and inquiry forms
purpose.database: Storing and serving the service database

transfer.retention: Until you delete your account or the service agreement with the company ends
transfer.refuse: If you object to this transfer, contact {contact}. The service cannot run without these companies, so if you object you won't be able to use it.
